strings.تبي بابًا يندمج مع الجدار، لكن محتار بين: Want a door that blends into the wall but unsure whether to choose hinged, sliding or pivot? The main differences are the movement and space each system requires. “Hidden” describes integration into the wall; it does not specify the opening mechanism or performance. Choose the type according to the room’s use and existing opening, then select a finish that complements your home in Kuwait.
